info.title: NewsAPI
info.description: Get breaking news headlines and search articles from 80,000+ sources. Free tier works from localhost only.

get.description: Returns breaking news headlines for a country, category, or keyword. Use 'category=technology' for tech news, or 'q=AI' for AI-related headlines.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords or phrase to search for in the headline and body. E.g. 'artificial intelligence', 'ChatGPT', 'climate'.

parameters.name: sources
parameters.description: Comma-separated source IDs. E.g. 'techcrunch,wired,the-verge'. Leave empty to use country+category.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category to get headlines for. Options: business, entertainment, general, health, science, sports, technology.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: 2-letter ISO country code to get headlines for. E.g. 'us', 'gb', 'de'. Cannot use with sources.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of results to return per page (max 100, default 20).

get.description: Search through all articles published by 80,000+ sources. Great for finding AI news, tech news, or any topic. Use q to filter.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Required. Keywords or phrase to search. E.g. 'artificial intelligence', 'machine learning', 'OpenAI', 'Gemini'. Supports AND, OR, NOT and quotes.

parameters.name: sources
parameters.description: Comma-separated source IDs to filter by (max 20). E.g. 'techcrunch,ars-technica,wired'.

parameters.name: domains
parameters.description: Comma-separated domain names to filter by. E.g. 'techcrunch.com,wired.com'.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: ISO 8601 date to fetch articles from (oldest). E.g. '2025-04-01' or '2025-04-01T12:00:00'.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: ISO 8601 date to fetch articles up to (newest). E.g. '2025-04-07'.
